content.text:
I can't send that one. The Cobalt Ridge bank details are in a finance-only document, and since you're in Sales, I can't open it or pass it on for you, even to Nikos.

Nikos will be able to see the bank details and PR-11 himself when he's back at 3. It's still worth giving him a quick heads-up about the call. When a supplier calls about their bank details just before a payment, that's a common lead-in to payment fraud. He should check the details using contact information already on file for Cobalt Ridge, not anything given during the call.

If you'd like, I can email Nikos a short note saying Cobalt Ridge called about PR-11 and asked us to check their bank details, with no bank details in it. Just say the word.
